input.quote: 12.4 For eighteen months after termination Customer will not solicit or engage any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term.
input.rationale: Clause 12.4 imposes a one-way restrictive covenant on Customer only: 18 months post-termination, covering any person employed by Vendor at any time during the term (not just personnel involved in the Services), and barring "engage" as well as "solicit" (effectively a no-hire). There is no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out and no mutuality, so it fails the playbook fallback on duration, scope, no-hire and carve-outs. It also conflicts with clause 12.3, which records that Customer has made no no-hire commitment and may hire persons responding to general recruitment. Preferred position is no non-solicit on Customer, so we delete 12.4; the fallback (mutual, 12 months, involved personnel, standard carve-outs) is offered in the comment.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted clause 12.4: our position is that Customer does not accept non-solicitation or no-hire restrictions, and an 18-month bar on soliciting or engaging any Vendor employee also contradicts clause 12.3. If Vendor needs protection, we can accept a mutual 12-month non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, with carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches and no no-hire.
proposal.summary: Delete the one-way 18-month non-solicit/no-hire binding Customer.
